articles.summary: Valeria Ambrese Head legal and compliance LKQ RHIAG Italy admin Mon, 06/24/2024 - 19:37 EMPLOYEE STORIES Valeria Ambrese Head of Legal and Compliance at LKQ RHIAG Italy Meet our Head of Legal and Compliance at LKQ RHIAG Italy Valeria Ambrese LKQ has been a great platform for me to grow. I was the first in-house legal counsel at LKQ RHIAG Italy in January 2021 – an opportunity that allowed me to challenge myself as I established and managed a function, taking our legal and compliance capabilities from strength to strength. No two days are the same. Even though I have similar daily routines, the people and projects I work with, and involved in, vary greatly. My team and I are here to make sure the way of working is conducted both correctly and legally within the organization in order to avoid potential risks to our company. I am now working as part of the central function, this gives me the opportunity to meet and talk to my colleagues across Europe which is fantastic, as despite the differences between our culture, languages, and legislations, we have the same goal to share best practices and create stronger, profitable and inclusive organizations. Lawyers are not enemies to businesses, but the windshield of an organization. articles.summary: Jareau Mantel Communication Manager at LKQ Benelux-France admin Mon, 06/24/2024 - 13:37 EMPLOYEE STORIES Jareau Mantel Communication Manager at LKQ Benelux-France Meet our Communication Manager at LKQ Benelux-France I’m lucky enough to have experienced both sides of communication – in my professional life. Before joining LKQ Europe, I was sometimes on the receiving end. So, I know how frustrating it can be when communication doesn’t make any sense and you can’t relate to it. But because I’ve been there, I now know how to avoid this type of confusion. The solution sounds simple – step away from your desk and get a fresh perspective. In my case, go to other departments or warehouses to talk to people. These valuable conversations are an insightful two-way street that lets me find out if what I’m doing is relatable. As part of our exchange, I can find out if people understand the intended message and the way it’s presented. It’s what I love most about my role – in communications, the learning curve never ends. Valuable conversations are an insightful two-way street that lets me find out if what I’m doing is relatable.
